title: Every visit logs a red 404 in the console: the bot check answers 404 when there is nothing to check

expected: A 200/204 'no challenge' answer, a clean console

ux: None for visitors; it hides real errors from developers and monitoring
perf: Return 204 or skip the call when no challenge is configured
